annotationMethod: Independent Astra Max source-only visual review and native pixel ROI verification. Projected pelvis/torso X is chosen independently of support-ROI X; Y reproduces exclusive alpha>=64 support extent. Per-army fresh contact half-up median is shared unchanged with casualty; no phase-height normalization.

groundMethods: Projected pelvis X selected independently. Ground Y is the alpha>=64 exclusive bottom of the nearer viewer-left/front boot sole, isolated below the trouser cuff; no rifle pixels.
Projected pelvis X follows the hips behind the forward lean. Ground Y comes from the nearer forward boot sole during the short SW extension, independently of the other boot and weapon.
Projected pelvis X follows the withdrawn torso/hips. Ground Y comes from the nearer viewer-left boot sole under the recovering leg.
Projected pelvis X follows the wide guard hips. Ground Y comes from the nearer viewer-left planted boot sole; the wider stance lowers projected body height naturally.
Projected pelvis X at the hips in the initial recoil. Ground Y is the lower nearer viewer-right boot sole, isolated from the SW-pointing rifle.
Projected pelvis X at the hips above the lowering knee. Ground Y is the underside of the nearer bracing palm/fingertips; the ROI excludes the rifle and other boot.
Projected pelvis X at the collapsing hips. Ground Y is the lower edge of the nearer supporting palm/fingertips, isolated from the rifle held by the other hand.

Projected pelvis/torso X at prone rest. Ground Y is the underside of the nearer resting hand/knuckles below the forearm; the selected narrow ROI excludes the adjacent rifle stock as the determining edge.
Projected pelvis X at the rear-view hips. Ground Y is the nearer viewer-right/front boot sole, separate from the rear boot and rifle.
Projected pelvis X follows the forward-reaching hips. Ground Y is the nearer trailing viewer-left boot sole; the forehand extension and hip-level stock do not define the root.
Projected pelvis X follows the withdrawn hips. Ground Y is the nearer viewer-right boot sole during the low recovery.
Projected pelvis X follows the braced guard hips. Ground Y is the nearer viewer-right boot sole under the flexed leg, independently of the projecting rifle.
Projected pelvis X follows the initial unsettled stance. Ground Y is the nearer viewer-right boot sole, isolated below the trouser cuff.
Projected pelvis X at the lowered hips. Ground Y is the underside of the lowered cream-trouser knee; the ROI excludes the rear vertical boot sole and outstretched palm.
Projected pelvis X at the collapsing hips. Ground Y is the underside of the nearer gray-sleeved bracing forearm/elbow, in a bounded ROI separated from the rifle stock below and to the left.
Projected pelvis/torso X at prone rest. Ground Y is the underside of the near cream-trouser upper leg/thigh left of the rifle stock; weapon and boot bounds are excluded.
